theorems.name: Submission.idtp_ccd_scsp_cc_square_shrink
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M U N₀ : Set (Euclid P)) (O : Set (Euclid 2)) (F : Euclid P → Euclid 2) (G : Euclid 2 → Euclid P) (p : Euclid P) (r₀ : ℝ), 0 < r₀ → IsOpen U → ContinuousOn F U → IsOpen O → IsOpen N₀ → F p = !₂[r₀, 0] → F p ∈ O → p ∈ N₀ → N₀ ⊆ U → G '' O = M ∩ N₀ → (∀ w ∈ O, F (G w) = w) → ∃ (s : ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid P)), 0 < s ∧ s < r₀ ∧ IsOpen N ∧ p ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ U ∧ {w : Euclid 2 | w 0 ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ∧ w 1 ∈ Ioo (-s) s} ⊆ O ∧ M ∩ N = G '' {w : Euclid 2 | w 0 ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ∧ w 1 ∈ Ioo (-s) s}
